gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-hind-gun: Love Ya Like A Sister hunkers down with ascenders that barely clear its x-height and terminals flicking outward, all loud and bold. Hind Guntur does the opposite job, a modern sans drawn like steel cable outline with wide gaps where curves meet stems.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-hind-mys: Hind Mysuru is a contemporary sans-serif whose lowercase tops press right up near the ascender height, with no calligraphic thinning anywhere. Love Ya Like A Sister sits above it, expressive and bold, its ascenders barely clearing the x-height.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-hind-vad: Love Ya Like A Sister keeps its ascenders barely above the x-height and flicks its terminals outward, giving a bold, expressive display look. Hind Vadodara adds spacious, uniform-weight sans letters whose open e and a feel generous.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-inter-ti: Inter Tight reads modern and businesslike, its lines like bent tubing and its ascenders barely poking above the lowercase. And Love Ya Like A Sister brings the bold, expressive swagger, its outward-pointing terminals loosening everything up.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-karla: Chunky, loud, and a bit goofy. Love Ya Like A Sister holds one constant pen width, while Karla, a modern sans, has a gaping c opening and a stocky middle band that make it feel friendly beside the display face.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-khula: Bold and a little swaggering, Love Ya Like A Sister draws every curve as thick as its straight stems. Khula answers with a roomy, brush-pen belly.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-krub: Krub has a pronounced x-height and curves where the pen seems to lift, leaving each loop unfinished. And Love Ya Like A Sister, tubular and wire-like, gives the top of the page its bold, expressive voice.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-lexend: Approachable in feel, Lexend uses outsized lowercase proportions and open jaws on every curve, with thickness holding steady around the bends. And Love Ya Like A Sister sits above it, bold and expressive, its ascenders barely clearing the x-height.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-liter: Love Ya Like A Sister is the loud one, expressive and bold, with ascenders barely clearing its x-height and terminals pointing outward. Liter is the quiet worker, a sans with no stroke contrast, great vertical presence and wide mouths on its round forms.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-mada: Bold, level, and unshaded, Love Ya Like A Sister holds a steady outline with outward-pointing terminal tips for real display swagger. Mada is the modern sans-serif that does the friendly work, its towering midzone and open curves staying easy on the eye.
